name: D-ID
tagline: D-ID is an AI video platform that animates still photos into talking, expressive video presenters. You upload a portrait and provide a script or audio track, and D-ID generates a realistic talking-head video in minutes. It's used for e-learning content, corporate communications, social media, and multilingual training videos at a fraction of traditional video production costs.
